name: zman
title: zman ⌂ NYC buys its buildings back
description: Mayor Mamdani's housing plan as a program on the openhouse framework: municipal bond series are sold to investors, the proceeds acquire New York buildings, and each building becomes an openhouse property with the city in both the owner and civic-authority seats at a 0% fee. Rent is split by openhouse into tenant equity and debt service; debt service is swept to bondholders pro-rata; the rent freeze is enforced in code. Testnet bookkeeping only.
